summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a Series A Global Medium-Term Notes takedown of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due November 1, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and EURO STOXX 50 indices. The notes are senior unsecured obligations issued at $1,000 per note with a monthly $8.33 contingent coupon, monthly autocall beginning roughly one year after pricing, and a threshold-based maturity payment exposing principal to the worst-performing index. This is an ordinary structured note shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch coupon-barrier levels and issuer credit risk.
